title: In-demo navigation to /demo never fetches dashboard data: deep-link boot + breadcrumb home strands on a permanent skeleton (regression from the r2 no-reseed fix)
detail: Boot on a demo deep link (e.g. /vacancies/v-maples) leaves vacancies NotAsked by design; clicking the breadcrumb 'Dashboard' home (href /demo in demo) hits `routes.Demo, True -> handle_browser_change`, whose fetch gate matches only routes.Dashboard — no fetch fires and dashboard.view_dashboard renders the skeleton forever. Violates AC1 'every landlord surface clickable in demo state' on a headline entry path.
recommended_fix: Extend the handle_browser_change dashboard fetch gate (and the Loading setter) to match `routes.Demo | routes.Dashboard` when demo_mode is True.

title: still present since round 2: Entering demo clobbers a live landlord session; exit downgrades auth to NotAsked
evidence:
model.gleam clear_demo_state: `demo_mode: False,
    demo_store: None,
    auth: NotAsked,` ; client.gleam enter_demo: `auth: Success(landlord),
          csrf_token: "demo-csrf-token",` ; exit arm: `handle_browser_change(model |> model.clear_demo_state, uri, route)` with no auth_api.check_session anywhere on the exit path
detail: The r2 recommended fix ('On exit, re-check session instead of downgrading to NotAsked; on entry, stash real auth aside') did not land: entry still overwrites a real Success(auth) with the mock landlord, and clear_demo_state still drops auth to NotAsked with no session re-check, so a previously-authed landlord appears logged out until a full reload.
recommended_fix: Fire auth_api.check_session(ApiReturnedSession) on demo exit to a public route (the cookie is still valid server-side), or stash and restore the prior auth around demo entry.

title: still present since round 2: Demo comparison ids and sweep-nudge dismissals still write to real web storage
detail: Demo-scoped ids still persist to session/localStorage and hydrate back on demo re-entry — a refresh-wipe exception to the spec's 'no persistence of any kind' (no real endpoint writes).
recommended_fix: Skip save_comparison_ids / save_dismissed_sweep_nudges when model.demo_mode is True, or use a demo-scoped storage key.

title: still present since round 2: Stale visibilitychange doc paragraph still sits on handle_browser_change
detail: The doc block describing listen_visibility_refresh is still attached to handle_browser_change; the actual listener function (line 5905) remains undocumented. The r1 #27 doc swap never happened.
recommended_fix: Move the paragraph back to listen_visibility_refresh.

title: still present since round 2: Dead routes.Demo arm in view_protected_page
detail: view_page matches routes.Demo before the protected fall-through and is_protected_route(Demo) is False, so view_protected_page's routes.Demo arm is unreachable leftover from an earlier routing shape.
recommended_fix: Delete the routes.Demo arm from view_protected_page.

title: still present since round 2: Demo boot skips the visibility-refresh listener and localStorage hydrations for the page lifetime
detail: After demo exit + SPA login without a reload, the multi-tab policy-sync listener and the sweep-nudge/refcheck hydration effects never install for the tab's lifetime.
recommended_fix: Install the listeners/hydrations on demo exit (or on first real auth after a demo boot).

title: still present since round 2: Latent: enter_demo keeps server_policy_version, so the policy re-acceptance modal could surface in demo and fire a real accept_policy POST
evidence:
enter_demo builds `Model(
          ..model,
          route:,
          auth: Success(landlord),
          csrf_token: "demo-csrf-token",
          demo_mode: True,` ... with no server_policy_version reset; fixture: `"accepted_policy_version":"2026-05-23"`; grep finds no UserAcceptedPolicy arm in demo_update.gleam
detail: An in-SPA /demo entry from a real-authed session keeps the real server_policy_version; if it postdates the mock landlord's accepted version the policy modal opens in demo and UserAcceptedPolicy reaches the real accept_policy POST with the demo CSRF token. Latent today (no authed-UI link to /demo).
recommended_fix: Set server_policy_version to "" in enter_demo (or intercept UserAcceptedPolicy in demo_update).

title: Edit deep-link boot fetches the payload (r2-B4 fixed) but never sets vacancy_edit_loading — the empty form renders instead of a skeleton until the response lands
detail: The VacancyEdit arm of demo_entry_effects now fires demo_api.get_for_edit (the r2-B4 blocker is fixed), but the second half of the recommended fix — vacancy_edit_loading: True in enter_demo — did not land, so a refresh on /vacancies/v-maples/edit flashes the empty form for a tick rather than the skeleton.
recommended_fix: Set vacancy_edit_loading: True in enter_demo when the route is VacancyEdit.
